command: set -euo pipefail; BASE=/workspace/frankgrid10-organ; OLD=$(cat "$BASE/run/organ-daemon.pid" 2>/dev/null || true); echo OLD_PID=$OLD; STATE=MISSING; if [ -n "$OLD" ] && [ -r "/proc/$OLD/stat" ]; then STATE=$(awk '{print $3}' "/proc/$OLD/stat"); fi; echo OLD_STATE=$STATE; if [ "$STATE" != Z ] && [ "$STATE" != MISSING ]; then echo OLD_PROCESS_STILL_EXECUTING >&2; ps -o pid,ppid,stat,etimes,cmd -p "$OLD" >&2 || true; exit 72; fi; test -z "$(find "$BASE/ipc/processing" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.json' -print -quit)"; test -z "$(find "$BASE/ipc/inbox" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.json' -print -quit)"; test -f "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py.new"; python3 -m py_compile "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py.new"; NEWSHA=$(sha256sum "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py.new"|awk '{print $1}'); mv "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py.new" "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py"; : > "$BASE/logs/organ-daemon.log"; nohup setsid python3 "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py" --poll 0.5 >>"$BASE/logs/organ-daemon.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null & PID=$!; echo "$PID" > "$BASE/run/organ-daemon.pid"; sleep 3; kill -0 "$PID"; NEWSTATE=$(awk '{print $3}' "/proc/$PID/stat"); test "$NEWSTATE" != Z; echo DAEMON_SOURCE_SHA256=$NEWSHA; echo NEW_PID=$PID; echo NEW_STATE=$NEWSTATE; cat "$BASE/run/heartbeat.json"; echo IDENTITY; cat "$BASE/identity/identity.json"; echo CURRENT_EPOCH; cat "$BASE/identity/current_epoch.json"; echo LOG_TAIL; tail -50 "$BASE/logs/organ-daemon.log" || true; echo FRANKGRID10_IDENTITY_RESOURCE_RECOVERY_PASS
